resources.string: The coach uses these values instead of the Intervals.icu ones. An empty field is not sent.
With at least 5 %1$s nights the app suggests the measured resting HR (now %2$s).
Maximum cardio hours per week (gym excluded)
Minutes available per day. 0 = day not available, empty = no limit.
On weekdays the coach schedules at most one cardio session, plus strength.
Available equipment: the coach picks strength sessions among those you can do.
Beginner: an adaptation session for the first 4 weeks.
On hot days, turn easy runs into indoor rides
The coach reads the forecast for this time.
Approximate location allowed: the coach uses the forecast for where you are.
Needed for the weather forecast: on hot days the coach adapts your runs. Without it the coach works the same, without the heat rules.
If Android no longer asks: Android Settings → Apps → %1$s → Permissions → Location.
Quality running sessions (hills, intervals, threshold) will use power. You need the CP on Intervals.icu (running FTP field): the coach updates it by itself from your runs with Stryd.

With DETP the coach adds heat adaptation sessions (heat blocks) and HSI targets to workouts. Always stop at the first symptoms (dizziness, nausea, chills). Not suitable if you are ill or have cardiovascular problems.
Values out of range: max HR 120–230, resting HR 30–100, hours 1–30, minutes 0–600.
Replanning in progress: it takes a few minutes, you can leave this screen.
Sessions from today to Sunday will be recalculated with this profile. Past sessions stay unchanged.
